schemes.name: loop_butterfly_open__d07_bar+
schemes.secondary_language: a four-storey loop ring whose every bar carries a butterfly roof draining toward the court - a basin of roofs over a garden of rain
schemes.formal_principle: The court is the ring's centre but a flat ring drains rain away from it; giving every bar a butterfly that drains toward the court makes the court a rain garden that the building actively feeds - the building is organised around its own hydrological logic, the butterfly valleys as gutters pointing inward.
schemes.dominant_gesture: a court ring of butterfly roofs draining to the court

ops.why: Input: a four-storey ring tall enough that the butterfly's valley is visible above the bar's eaves; height 0.65 declares mid-tall. Bar 0.23 gives each arm enough depth for a readable butterfly across its short dimension. Limit: four storeys keep the ring civic-scaled; bar 0.23 avoids making the arms too deep for the butterfly to register.

Input: the butterfly valley runs along each bar's cross axis (parallel to the court edge) so the valley is the deepest point closest to the court; at 0.3 biases the valley toward the court face so the deep wing is over the court and the shallow wing faces outward. Limit: pitch 0.55 on bar depth 0.23 reads cleanly within the cap; along cross runs the valley perpendicular to each bar's own length.

schemes.formal_principle: Lift a narrow transverse strip of the underside to form a covered ground passage through the central body and rear wall. The continuous upper volume frames the two carved courts while the retained north and south masses remain grounded.

design_argument_ko.title: Perforated base beneath a continuous upper body
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: Lift a narrow transverse strip of the underside to form a covered ground passage through the central body and rear wall. The continuous upper volume frames the two carved courts while the retained north and south masses remain grounded.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: The passage is a modeled void, not a verified door, circulation route or engineered transfer structure. Its upper bridge needs structural development.

schemes.name: field_under_butterfly_wings
schemes.secondary_language: five three-storey pavilions standing apart, each under a V-shaped butterfly roof - valleys catching the rain in the middle of every roof
schemes.formal_principle: Rain and daylight both want to be collected at the centre of each pavilion, so every roof folds inward as a butterfly: five valleys in a field, each pavilion's two wings lifting its eaves outward to the yard.

ops.why: Input: five pavilions in a yard. Limit: height 0.55 declares mid; spread 1.6 keeps yard between.
Input: each pavilion collects rain and light at its centre. Limit: pitch 0.8 keeps the valley inside the cap on pavilions this size.

schemes.name: oval_dome_hall_sunk
schemes.secondary_language: a low oval hall whose own top rises to a dome, its floor sunk a half-level so the dome sits low to the street
schemes.formal_principle: One figure, one section: the oval plan has no corners to answer the parcel's skew, the domed top makes the hall's centre its tallest room, and sinking the floor keeps the dome low to the street so the building reads as a single civic volume rather than a drum.
schemes.dominant_gesture: an oval hall crowned by a dome, sunk to the street
schemes.design_argument_ko: 타원 평면에 돔 지붕, 바닥을 낮춰 거리에서 낮게 읽힌다.

ops.why: An oval plan turns the skewed parcel into a figure with no corner to resolve; three storeys under the five-storey law.
The hall's own top rises to its centre - the tallest room is the middle one, so the section says what the plan says.
A quarter of the body below grade keeps the dome low to the street and gives the hall a lower entry level.

schemes.name: comp17_folded_edge_and_room
schemes.secondary_language: 접힌 단면의 긴 몸체와 낮은 실내 몸체가 맞물리고 전면의 파인 공간이 진입 여백을 만든다.
schemes.formal_principle: 접힌 단면의 긴 몸체와 낮은 실내 몸체가 맞물리고 전면의 파인 공간이 진입 여백을 만든다.
schemes.reference_basis: Original relational authorship following the supplied reference study; no building attribution or programme compliance claim.

ops.why: Start from an occupied envelope inside the supplied storey ceiling, with no invented FAR target.
Name the main room and side room before modifying their sections, retaining contact.
Fold only the principal room roof, keeping the smaller body legible; no structural shell claim.
Open a substantial front recess in the actual body as an entrance-space hypothesis; doors and accessible paths remain unresolved.

schemes.name: podium_edge_tower
schemes.secondary_language: the rotated tower is shifted to the open-side edge of the podium so three faces of ground become one gathered civic apron and the street reads a clear corner address
schemes.formal_principle: 부모의 탑은 기단 한가운데에 얹혀 세 면의 남은 지붕이 잔여물이 되었다. 탑을 열린 변 모서리로 민 뒤 기단 세 면이 한 방향의 내부 마당으로 모이고, 거리는 탑 모서리와 직접 만난다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: 모서리 탑과 한쪽으로 몰린 기단 테라스
schemes.reference_basis: development of comp19_tower_twisting_above_compact_podium: the half-plot vertical seed, the four-storey podium, the rotated tower and the open-side carve are all kept; what changes is where the tower is placed on the podium lid

design_argument_ko.title: 탑을 한쪽 모서리로 밀어 기단 지붕이 한 방향의 마당이 된다.
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: 부모에서 탑은 기단 중심에 있어 나머지 기단 지붕이 사방의 잔여 여백이 됐다. 열린 변 쪽 모서리에 탑을 붙이면 나머지 기단 지붕이 하나의 연속된 업무 테라스가 되고, 거리에서는 탑 모서리가 정면이 된다.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: 이동한 탑은 기단 가장자리의 구조 연속성을 요구하고, 기단 지붕의 외부 이용 및 방수는 검증이 필요하다.

moving the tower toward the open side consolidates the unused podium lid into one directed terrace rather than a residue on three sides. Developed: op None -> shift, ratio None -> 0.32, toward None -> open, on None -> nest_volume, chosen over the parent by a unanimous blind pairwise jury.

schemes.name: stagger_tower_on_podium
schemes.secondary_language: the rotated tower is replaced by a nested mass that steps progressively toward the open side level by level, so the tower leans rather than rotates and each floor plate has a different view
schemes.formal_principle: 부모의 탑은 평면이 돌아 꼭대기가 대각선을 향했지만, 매 층에서 같은 자리에 서 있었다. 탑을 층마다 열린 변 쪽으로 조금씩 미끄러지게 하면 탑이 기울어지며 층마다 더 많은 전면부를 향하게 되고, 단면에서 기울어진 피크가 된다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: 열린 변 쪽으로 층마다 미끄러지는 기울어진 탑
schemes.reference_basis: development of comp19_tower_twisting_above_compact_podium: the half-plot vertical seed, four-storey podium, open-side carve and nested tower position are kept; the rotation (turn) is replaced by stagger — this differs from O24 (four masses alternately shifted between faces) and O6 (blocks alternating orientation) because only the tower stagger is the proposition and it is one-directional toward the open side

design_argument_ko.title: 탑을 회전 대신 층마다 열린 변으로 미끄러뜨려 기울어진 탑이 된다.
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: 부모의 탑은 수직으로 서서 평면이 돌아갔다. 동일 방향으로 층마다 이동하면 탑이 기울어지며 상층부가 더 많은 도로 전면을 향한다. 기단 위 기울어진 매스는 하부 기단과 상부 탑 사이의 긴장 관계를 단면에서 읽히게 한다.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: stagger가 누적되면 상층부가 기단 가장자리를 넘어 캔틸레버 상태가 될 수 있다. 구조 가능 여부는 미검증이다. 탑의 층고 및 기단과의 하중 전달은 독립 검토가 필요하다.
